description: Worker + client delivery: stop sampling not_found to 1/60s, tag every cycle with cycleNumber + a stable windowId + idempotencyKey, buffer each cycle result in-memory per worker, and flush as a BATCH every SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS / SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX rows / on window-end, via a new batched client sender that posts to the FEAT-001 route. Depends on FEAT-001 (route + mutation + schema fields must exist).
steps: convexClient.ts: export interface SpainWatcherScanRow { status: "found"|"not_found"|"error"; cycleNumber: number; windowId: number; idempotencyKey: string; applicationId?: string; dossierName?: string; slotInfo?: string; detectedServices?: string; detectedSlots?: string; scanTrace?: string; errorMessage?: string; screenshotStorageId?: string; }.

convexClient.ts: add export async function reportSpainWatcherScanBatch(scans: SpainWatcherScanRow[]): Promise<void>. Return early if scans.length === 0. POST { scans } to `${CONVEX_SITE_URL}/hunter/spain-watcher/scan-result/batch` via fetchWithRetry (so transient 503 is retried). On non-2xx: const text = await res.text(); console.warn(`[convexClient] reportSpainWatcherScanBatch failed: ${res.status} count=${scans.length} ${text}`). Wrap in try/catch and console.warn network errors with the count. Do NOT silently swallow. Keep reportSpainWatcherScan unchanged.
spain-dossier-worker.ts: import reportSpainWatcherScanBatch and type SpainWatcherScanRow from ./convexClient.js (type-only import for the interface).

spain-dossier-worker.ts: next to windowEndEarly (~2275-2285) compute `const windowId: number`: if bypassWindow -> windowEndEarly - WORKER_WINDOW_MS; else new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), now.getHours(), 0, 0, 0).getTime(). Keep windowId in scope for the whole scan loop and the finally block.

spain-dossier-worker.ts: remove WATCHER_NOTFOUND_THROTTLE_MS and lastNotFoundReportAtMs (~2674-2676) and the throttle comment. Introduce const SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS (default 20000, bounded [5000,120000]) and SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX (default 25, bounded [1,200]) as module-level consts read from process.env. Add a per-worker `const cycleScanBuffer: SpainWatcherScanRow[] = []` and an async `flushScanBuffer()` that, if the buffer is non-empty, splices the current rows out, awaits reportSpainWatcherScanBatch(rows), and on throw logs `[spain-worker] flush failed` and re-queues the rows at the front (so nothing is advanced/lost before a successful send). Start a setInterval(flushScanBuffer, SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS) stored in a handle; clear it in finally.

spain-dossier-worker.ts: add an enqueue helper that builds a SpainWatcherScanRow with status, cycleNumber: cycleCount, windowId, idempotencyKey: `${windowId}:${config.applicationId ?? '_'}:${cycleCount}`, scanTrace: JSON.stringify(workerTrace), plus the branch-specific fields, pushes it onto cycleScanBuffer, and if cycleScanBuffer.length >= SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX triggers void flushScanBuffer().
spain-dossier-worker.ts: replace the throttled not_found reportSpainWatcherScan call (~3059-3070) with an enqueue (status not_found, scanTrace from workerTrace, applicationId, dossierName).

spain-dossier-worker.ts: replace the found/eligible reportSpainWatcherScan call (~3176-3190) with an enqueue carrying status (found if eligible.length>0 else not_found), slotInfo, detectedServices, detectedSlots, scanTrace, applicationId, dossierName, cycle/window ids. The found email alert is now triggered server-side by the batch route's best-effort internalTouchSingleton (FEAT-001), so no separate found report is needed; confirm the booking path and sendHeartbeat calls remain untouched.
spain-dossier-worker.ts: in the finally block (~4108+), clear the flush interval handle and await flushScanBuffer() one last time so remaining cycles are delivered before the worker returns.

.env.example: add a `# ── Spain — télémétrie des cycles (batch) ──` block documenting SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS (défaut 20000), SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX (défaut 25), SPAIN_SCAN_RETENTION_HOURS (défaut 48, côté Convex) and a note that chaque cycle produit désormais exactement une ligne d'historique (plus d'échantillonnage 1/60s).
acceptance_criteria: WATCHER_NOTFOUND_THROTTLE_MS and lastNotFoundReportAtMs are gone; no throttle timestamp is advanced before a successful send.

Every cycle (not_found and found/eligible branches) enqueues exactly one SpainWatcherScanRow with cycleNumber=cycleCount, a stable windowId, and idempotencyKey `${windowId}:${applicationId|_}:${cycleNumber}`, preserving the rich scanTrace/detectedSlots payload.
The buffer flushes on a SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS timer, when it reaches SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX, and once more in the worker finally before return; a failed flush re-queues rows rather than dropping them.
reportSpainWatcherScanBatch posts an array via fetchWithRetry and logs non-2xx failures with the row count (no silent swallow); reportSpainWatcherScan is unchanged.
.env.example documents SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS / SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX / SPAIN_SCAN_RETENTION_HOURS with defaults matching the code.
The found/booking path and sendHeartbeat behavior are unchanged.
verification: grep for WATCHER_NOTFOUND_THROTTLE_MS in artifacts/slot-hunter/src/spain-dossier-worker.ts returns nothing
Manual review: idempotencyKey format and windowId derivation match context.json; finally block clears the interval and awaits a final flush.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Files touched (worktree only): artifacts/slot-hunter/src/convexClient.ts, artifacts/slot-hunter/src/spain-dossier-worker.ts, artifacts/slot-hunter/.env.example.

CLIENT (convexClient.ts): added `export interface SpainWatcherScanRow { status: 'found'|'not_found'|'error'; cycleNumber: number; windowId: number; idempotencyKey: string; applicationId?; dossierName?; slotInfo?; detectedServices?; detectedSlots?; scanTrace?; errorMessage?; screenshotStorageId? }` and `export async function reportSpainWatcherScanBatch(scans: SpainWatcherScanRow[]): Promise<void>` which returns early on empty, POSTs { scans } to `${CONVEX_SITE_URL}/hunter/spain-watcher/scan-result/batch` via fetchWithRetry (so transient 503 from OCC is retried), logs non-2xx with `[convexClient] reportSpainWatcherScanBatch failed: ${status} count=${n} ${text}` and network errors with the count — no silent swallow. reportSpainWatcherScan left unchanged.

WORKER (spain-dossier-worker.ts): removed WATCHER_NOTFOUND_THROTTLE_MS + lastNotFoundReportAtMs + throttle comment (grep confirms gone). Removed the now-unused reportSpainWatcherScan import; added reportSpainWatcherScanBatch + type-only SpainWatcherScanRow import.

WINDOW ID (near windowEndEarly): `const windowId: number = bypassWindow ? windowEndEarly - WORKER_WINDOW_MS : new Date(y,m,d,hour,0,0,0).getTime()` (top-of-hour epoch ms of worker-start hour). In scope for the whole scan loop + finally.

TELEMETRY (declared BEFORE the try so the finally can see them — same pattern as holdingBookingSlot): `let cycleCount = 0;` moved before try; `const cycleScanBuffer: SpainWatcherScanRow[] = []`; `flushScanBuffer()` splices all rows, awaits reportSpainWatcherScanBatch, on throw logs `[spain-worker] flush failed` and unshifts rows back (nothing lost/advanced before a successful send); `enqueueScanRow(row)` fills cycleNumber=cycleCount, windowId, idempotencyKey and pushes, triggering `void flushScanBuffer()` when buffer >= SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX; `const flushIntervalHandle = setInterval(() => void flushScanBuffer(), SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS)`. Both scan branches (not_found ~3059 and found/eligible ~3176) now call enqueueScanRow instead of reportSpainWatcherScan, preserving the rich scanTrace/detectedSlots/detectedServices/slotInfo payload. finally clears the interval and awaits a final flushScanBuffer() before the other cleanup. Found/booking path + sendHeartbeat untouched (the found email alert is now server-side via the batch route's internalTouchSingleton).

ENV VARS (worker-side, read module-level with bounds):
  SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MS  default 20000, bounded [5000, 120000].
  SPAIN_SCAN_FLUSH_MAX default 25,    bounded [1, 200] (floored).
  SPAIN_SCAN_RETENTION_HOURS is Convex-side (FEAT-001); documented here too (default 48, bounded [1,720]).
All three documented in artifacts/slot-hunter/.env.example under a new `# ── Spain — télémétrie des cycles (batch) ──` block, with the note that chaque cycle produit désormais exactement une ligne (plus d'échantillonnage 1/60s).

IDEMPOTENCY KEY FORMAT (for the frontend / FEAT-003): `${windowId}:${applicationId ?? '_'}:${cycleNumber}` — windowId = top-of-hour epoch ms, cycleNumber = scan cycle index within the window (starts at 1, incremented at loop top). Group frontend rows by windowId desc then cycleNumber desc; rows without ids -> 'Hors cycle'.
